reels.summary:

The trip could include discussions on AI policy and trade, plus a historic trilateral meeting between Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

reels.title: Nvidia interim CEO Colette Kress tells Jim Cramer demand is only increasing
reels.summary:
In her first interview since Jensen Huang’s abrupt departure from Nvidia, interim CEO Colette Kress told CNBC’s Jim Cramer that “the most important thing we have seen is growth in the demand that’s out there.”

Nvidia said it expected 75% growth in the next year, higher than the company’s previous forecast of 70%.
